title: How old Lester was when he left home
summary: Lee says Lester first ran off at 11 or 12 to avoid his father's razor strap Greasy Jim, and left for good around 18 from Salina, Kansas.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: How old was Lester when he left home? I don't think we really established that. Or, do you remember exactly?
I wouldn't remember exactly, because I would have to discern when was the first time he left home.
Well, if you remember how old he
was when he first took off ...
No, he ... see, as I stated earlier, Lester used to run off every time my dad would raise a belt to him.
What would he do to upset your father?

Well, my father was a very strict man, you know, and he lived by the Golden Rule -- that it doesn't have to be -- that if you did anything that he told you not to do, you know, you would have to go and get "Greasy Jim" -- that was the name of his razor strap, you know. Well, I would go and get it and just stand up there and really take mine, but you couldn't do that to Lester -- because he would leave home.
I would say that the first time Lester left home, he was probably 11 or 12 years old when he run off from home.
And then when he left for good, he was about how old?

Oh, he must have been' around 18; I don't think he was any older than that, but he left for good -- the last time I think he ran off was in Salina, Kansas. Salina, Kansas -- and the reason I can remember that was because we'd been to Dodge City, and I'd seen some football games, high school football games in Dodge City. And Hill City -- I think there is a Hill City in Kansas, also, and we were playing all
around there, Topeka and Lawrence and all those little places.
